transcript: Speaker A: Sir, aapke liye normal paani laaun ya juice? [Sir, should I bring normal water or juice for you?] Speaker B: I would prefer a glass of sparkling water please, and could you also bring an extra blanket? It's quite chilly in here. Speaker A: Right away, sir. Waise sir, aapki English bahut fluent aur impressive hai. [Right away, sir. By the way sir, your English is very fluent and impressive.] Speaker B: Thank you madam. Par kuchh mahine pehle tak meri aisi haalat thi ki flight mein English sunkar mujhe dar lagta tha. [Thank you madam. But until a few months ago, my condition was such that I used to feel scared hearing English on a flight.] Speaker A: Oh! To aapne itni jaldi, itni faraatedar English kahan se seekhi? Koi expensive class? [Oh! So where did you learn such fluent English so quickly? Any expensive class?] Speaker B: Nahin, maine SpeakEasy app se seekhi. Ye normal classes se 7 guna cheaper hai. Sach kahun to mere ek din ke Swiggy kharche se bhi kam hai. [No, I learned from the SpeakEasy app. It is 7 times cheaper than normal classes. To be honest, it's less than my one day's Swiggy expense.] Speaker A: Aur sir, aapko baithkar padhne ka time kaise mila? [And sir, how did you find the time to sit and study?] Speaker B: Ismein boring classes nahi hai. Sab kuchh practical hi hota hai. Simple tarike se roz din mein 15 se 20 minutes AI teacher ke sath practice ki, aur 15 dino mein hi main fluent ho gaya. [It doesn't have boring classes. Everything is practical. I practiced with an AI teacher for 15 to 20 minutes daily in a simple way, and became fluent in just 15 days.] Speaker A: Kya ismein sirf AI se practice hoti hai? [Does it only have practice with AI?] Speaker B: Sirf AI hi nahi, baat karke practice karne ke liye 1 crore se zyada real log bhi hain is app mein. [Not just AI, there are also more than 1 crore real people in this app to practice by talking.] Speaker A: To agar aap bhi inki tarah confidently bolna chahte hain, to install button par click karke SpeakEasy app download kar lijiye. Pehle teen dino ka trial sirf ₹1 mein hai. [So if you also want to speak confidently like him, click on the install button and download the SpeakEasy app. The first three days' trial is for just ₹1.] Speaker C: Abhi SpeakEasy app download karein aur faraatedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
